name: TeXslate
tagline: Write and compile LaTeX documents right on your tablet
description:
TeXslate is a native LaTeX and XeTeX editor built for Android, with a layout designed to work well on tablets. Write your document, then compile it straight to PDF without needing a computer.

It runs fully offline using its own built-in typesetting engine, so you can work on papers, notes, or reports wherever you are.
